title: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows FAQ_EDIT…
description: phpMyFAQ versions from 4.2.0-alpha up to but not including 4.2.0-RC.2 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw allows users with FAQ_EDIT privileges to bypass the SvgSanitizer by using namespace-prefixed elements such as <x:script>. Malicious SVG files uploaded via the admin image upload feature can execute scripts in the context of the site on IIS servers, potentially hijacking sessions of privileged users including super-admins.
